summary: Reviewed all 46 iOS Swift/config files, all 94 React/JS/CSS files, and all 21 legacy static-tree files per file-inventory.json. This codebase shows clear evidence of prior remediation for this exact gap class (inline comments citing past fixes like 'compile-errors #2', 'dependency-errors #9'). Remaining findings: (High) AccountView.swift's load() applies its own statsFailed error-surfacing pattern to only 3 of 7 concurrent fetches, leaving user/usage/friendRequests/contacts on the old silent try?-swallow pattern the surrounding comments describe fixing elsewhere in the same function; React hooks useBookmarks.js, useHighlights.js, and useAgentChat.js use bare `catch {}` with optimistic local-state updates and zero error signal or rollback, reproducing the same bug class already fixed in AccountView.swift/DashboardView.swift/useMessaging.js/useNotes.js. (Medium) MessageAttachments.swift/MessageGroupRow.swift switch on attachmentKind as a raw String with a default: catch-all instead of the app's own exhaustively-switched AttachmentKind enum; AppState.swift uses default: instead of @unknown default: on UNAuthorizationStatus, inconsistent with StoreKitManager.swift's correct usage of the same pattern; StoreKitManager.swift's currentRenewal() has one remaining silent try? swallow in an otherwise fully-instrumented file. (Low) the legacy static JS tree has pervasive bare/comment-only catch blocks across session.js/highlights.js/bible.js/notes.js/messaging.js/dashboard.js on the one surface with zero test coverage; neither JS surface has any compile-time type checking (no TypeScript/PropTypes/ESLint) at all, noted structurally rather than as a line-level defect. Several grep hits (try! on constant regexes, layerClass-guaranteed as! cast, .utf8 data literals, and all other enum switches) were verified as safe by construction and are documented as ruled-out false positives rather than findings.
